title: Convergence of an IP DG Method for the Quad-Curl Problem
summary: This work analyzes revises the interior penalty (IP) discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method imposed in [Chen, G., Qiu, W., \& Xu, L. (2021). Analysis of an interior penalty DG method for the quad-curl problem. IMA Journal of Numerical Analysis, 41(4), 2990-3023.] for the quad-curl problem in a nonconvex polyhedral domain, while introducing a piecewise constant coefficient matrix. We derive two main results: Under minimal regularity assumptions, we prove that the numerical solutions converge strongly to the true solution in the $ H(\text{curl}) \times H^1(Ω)$ norm.
